Former Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola has expressed his admiration for Jürgen Klopp, describing the German coach as one of the best figures in football and insisting that the game needs personalities like him. Guardiola praised Klopp’s charisma, communication skills and influence on football, saying he was delighted to hear that his former managerial rival had returned to coaching. According to football transfer expert on X on Thursday, Guardiola said “Klopp is one of the best in football. I cannot even begin to describe how much I admire him,” Guardiola said, according to Bundesliga Magazine, via @iMiaSanMia. “He is the kind of personality, the kind of coach, who makes our footballing world a better place. He has charisma and is an incredible communicator.” The Spaniard also expressed confidence in Klopp’s ability to inspire the German national team and help restore the supporters’ pride in their country. Whether they win the next Euros or the World Cup, nobody can say. “But I’m 100% convinced that German fans will once again be proud of their national team,” he added. Guardiola and Klopp shared one of football’s most memorable managerial rivalries during their respective spells at Manchester City and Liverpool, competing for major honours in English football. Despite their intense battles on the pitch, Guardiola’s latest comments underline the mutual respect between two influential figures in modern football.
